description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called SettingsRootView used for displaying and managing different settings tabs in a macOS application. It includes UI components, state management, and interactions for navigating between settings pages, monitoring permissions, and handling app-specific behaviors.

classes.name: SettingsRootView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that manages and displays various settings tabs in the application.

methods.name: validTab
methods.description: Determines a valid SettingsTab, defaulting to general if debug tab is requested but debug pane is disabled.

methods.name: refreshSnapshotPaths
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the snapshot paths used for configuration and state directory banners.

methods.name: refreshPerms
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the permission monitor status.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring
methods.description: Enables or disables permission monitoring based on the selected tab.
